acceptance_gate: Blind update on the full state table; compare exact four-distinction outcome laws for every reachable context with the same restricted triple.
completion_gate: Evaluate both probability and support sufficiency for knotted and free triples, measure a new interaction involving the fourth, and give a checked witness or exhaustive equality certificate.
dependency_text: The two closed experiments supply the eight-cut probabilities, the signed conservative transition, the 11-distinction context totals, and the two possible three-distinction relations.
objective: Compare the next four-distinction relation across older contexts that give the same anonymous new triple. Test exactly what the knot predicts about the fourth addition, using a free triple as the comparison. Serves G16 and the intuition of rules within rules.
status: The same three-distinction knot admits different sets of fourth outcomes across older contexts. A fourth bound with an earlier pair in 98.17% under a knotted triple and 73.26% under a free triple. Independent enumeration and literal replays verified the result.
stop_rule: Stop after one fourth addition from the reachable eleven-distinction contexts in this lineage.
title: Does a knot on three new distinctions determine the possibilities for the fourth?
